tutorials.description: How to generate and connect a Hollow Knight: Silksong Archipelago seed.
tutorials.text: # Silksong Archipelago Randomizer An Archipelago randomizer for *Hollow Knight: Silksong*. It randomizes Silksong checks and items into an Archipelago multiworld, allowing several players to share item progression across supported games. The randomizer includes progression items, useful items, filler, and traps, with in-game map and item feedback to help track the run. This project is currently being tested and improved. Expect occasional bugs or logic changes between releases. ## Table of Contents - [Table of Contents](#table-of-contents) - [What is randomized?](#what-is-randomized) - [Requirements and Installation](#requirements-and-installation) - [Installation with Cogfly](#using-cogfly-125) - [Installation with R2Modman / Thunderstore Manager](#using-r2modman-3218--thunderstore-manager-11231) - [Manual Installation](#manually) - [Archipelago Setup](#archipelago-setup) - [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](#frequently-asked-questions-faq) - [Support and Additional Information](#support-and-additional-information) - [Credits](#credits) - [Logic Mapping](#logic-mapping) - [Contributors](#contributors) ## What is randomized? The world can randomize Silksong checks and progression items, including movement abilities, tools, crests, maps, mask shards, silk skills, fleas, and other useful or filler items. Traps may also be enabled depending on the generation settings. The exact checks and options available can change as the randomizer develops. Use the generated YAML template and the release notes for the current version. ## Requirements and Installation - *Hollow Knight: Silksong* on PC - BepInEx configured for Silksong - Archipelago (v0.6.7+) - The Archipelago client included with the release or your Archipelago installation There are multiple installation methods due to different issues with each of them at times, follow one of the methods below to install the Archipelago randomizer. ### Using Cogfly (1.2.5+) 1.) First start off by installing [Cogfly](https://github.com/Nix-main/Cogfly/releases/latest) to the latest version for your preferred operating system. 2.) Launch Cogfly and go to settings and make sure your path to your Silksong installation are valid. 3.) Go to profiles, select import from code, and enter the following profile code. The profile code contains the Archipelago Randomizer Mod, Custom Music Randomizer, Crest Wheel, Silksong Archip Display, Recent Items Display, Mod Menu, Mod List, and all other dependencies (CanvasUtil, DataManager, FsmUtil, I18N, BepInExPack_Silksong, Monodeteour_BepInEx_5, UnityHelper, MonoDetour, WavLib). > [!WARNING] > If you get an error when importing a code into Cogfly, especially the error below, refer to [here](#cogfly---getting-a-server-returned-http-response-code-502-error): > > **Server returned HTTP response code: 502 for URL** **NOTE: Please make sure to press "Update Mods" when installing or when new versions release and it'll automatically update you to the latest version of the mod.** **Cogfly Import Code:** `01a199f2-e780-ee3e-dcf9-9cdff4c98dce` (Same as R2Modman) ### Using R2Modman (3.2.18+) / Thunderstore Manager (1.123.1+) 1.) First start off by installing [R2Modman](https://r2modman.com/download-latest/) to the latest version for your preferred operating system. 2.) Select Hollow Knight: Silksong in the Game Selection Menu and select your Silksong storefront. 3.) In profile selection, select 'Import / Update', select 'From code', and enter the following profile code. The profile code contains the Archipelago Randomizer Mod, Custom Music Randomizer, Crest Wheel, Silksong Archip Display, Recent Items Display, Mod Menu, Mod List, and all other dependencies (CanvasUtil, DataManager, FsmUtil, I18N, BepInExPack_Silksong, Monodeteour_BepInEx_5, UnityHelper, MonoDetour, WavLib). **NOTE: Please make sure to press "Update Mods" when installing or when new versions release and it'll automatically update you to the latest version of the mod.** **R2Modman Import Code:** `01a199f2-e780-ee3e-dcf9-9cdff4c98dce` (Same as Cogfly) ### Manually 1.) Find your Hollow Knight: Silksong installation folder based on your Silksong storefront. 2.) Download the latest release of [BepInEx](https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases) for your preferred operating system. 3.) Drag all the contents of the BepInEx zip file that you downloaded into your Silksong game folder where the game's .exe resides. 4.) Launch Silksong once for the BepInEx files to initialize and then close the game. 5.) Download the Silksong Randomizer's [latest release](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer/releases/latest) .rar file. 6.) There will be a folder named "PUT IN SILKSONG FOLDER" with a 'BepInEx' folder inside it. Drag the 'BepInEx' folder from the zip file into your Silksong installation folder. This will merge or prompt you to merge the folders which is what you want to do. The resulting folder structure should look something like: ``` - 📂 BepInEx | - 📂 plugins | - 📂 Silksong Randomizer | - 📂 config | - 📂 core | - 📂 patchers - 📂 D3D12 - 📂 Hollow Knight Silksong_Data - 📂 MonoBleedingEdge - 📜 Hollow Knight Silksong.exe ``` **OPTIONAL**: If you want any of the other additional mods mentioned, you can find them on Thunderstore, download them, and place them into the 'plugins' folder found in the 'BepInEx' folder in your Silksong game installation folder. ## Archipelago Setup 1.) Download the [Archipelago Launcher](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest) for your preferred operating system. 2.) Download the Silksong Randomizer's [latest release](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer/releases/latest) .apworld file. 3.) Launch the Archipelago Launcher and drag the .apworld file into the client. Restart the Archipelago Launcher after installing the apworld. 4.) You can then generate a options configuration for yourself using one of the following two methods: - Press the "Options Creator" on the Launcher. Select Hollow Knight: Silksong on the left hand side of the screen that pops up and select all your preferred options. Finally, press export options and save it. - Press the "Generate Template Options" on the Launcher which will create .yaml's for all your installed .apworlds. Look for the 'Hollow Knight Silksong.yaml' file, this will be the file you edit for your options. 5.) Take the file that you generated in step 4 and place it in your Archipelago 'Players' folder alongside any other yaml that you will be using for your multiworld. 6.) Go back to the Archipelago Launcher and press generate. A script will run that will generate your multiworld seed and place a .zip file into your Archipelago 'output' folder. 7.) You can then upload the zip to host the game as you wish. Archipelago's upload hosting page can be found [here](https://archipelago.gg/uploads). ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) ### I Got to Act 3 and Missed Some Checks in Act 2? Some items become unavailable once you enter Act 3. Go to your Bellhome in Bellhart. Once you reach act 3 once, sit on the bed, press dash + needolin to get a pop-up asking to revert the world back to Act 2 and vice versa. ### What Are the Map Markers Showing? When enabled in the yaml "location_map_markers", the map can show randomized locations at their physical locations. Key for these markers are as follows: - **Fully opaque (with AP style rosary icon)**: Reachable / in logic. - **Half transparent (with AP style rosary icon)**: Not reachable / not in logic. - **? / inverted icons**: Missing logic so far / guaranteed junk. ### I’m Stuck Somewhere, What Do I Do? **Press F4.** Seriously. It allows warping to homepoints like Bone Bottom, Bellhart, and Songclave as you reach them, skips the widow cutscene to stop softlocks and can save you from the slab. Also you can press F3 and it'll allow changing of warp locations as of v0.4.3. ### Do You Have a Feature like Benchwarp? Short answer, no. Please refer to I’m stuck somewhere, what do I do? Long answer, it can cause softlocks and other issues, it can be used but at your own risk of issues and potential woodchipper related incidents. ### I Got An Error Saying My APWorld Version is Incompatible This occurs when you've changed your Randomizer Mod to a new version for an update while having your world generated on an old one. Use one of the installation methods to downgrade. Manual is preferred for downgrading. Given that Cogfly has some issues currently with import codes, you can downgrade manually by pressing the link attached to the version numbers below and then follow the steps. Alternatively, you can always replace Cogfly with a different mod manager that allows for downgrading. Downgrading on those mod managers can typically be done by uninstalling the mod and then reinstalling it and selecting the appropriate version to your generated run. #### Manual Downgrading 1.) Go to your BepInEx plugins folder, depending on your install this is located in one of two places. - For a manual installation it should be in your game directory. - For a mod manager, you want to go into the profile folder. For R2ModMan, this is in "Settings > Profile Folder". For Cogfly, go into the profile and press "Open Profile Folder". 2.) Go into the "BepInEx" folder. Go into the "plugins" folder. Go into the "Silksong Randomizer" folder this can also be named "BatAtVideoGames-SilksongArchipelagoRandomizer". A file named "SilksongRandomizer.dll" will be present in the folder, you want to replace this file using the version in one of the .rar files from below. 3.) Start up your game normally after replacing and you should be able to connect once again. #### Old Import Codes [**v0.5.4**](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer/releases/tag/v0.5.4) Import Code: `01a199f2-e780-ee3e-dcf9-9cdff4c98dce` [**v0.5.3**](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer/releases/tag/v0.5.3) Import Code: `01a18ae7-61f6-2d35-4c42-ed7578c6fc75` [**v0.5.2**](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer/releases/tag/v0.5.2) Import Code: `01a15150-4496-f47c-5102-41aae48899c7` [**v0.5.1**](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer/releases/tag/v0.5.1) Import Code: `01a12cf3-f4cb-5402-d6a8-0f266b3e7aa8` [**v0.5.0**](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer/releases/tag/v0.5.0) Import Code: `01a109ba-4c4f-b4f0-8695-8b4d42cb8159` ### My Mod Manager Boots The Game In Vanilla For **Cogfly**, press 'Copy Launch Arguments' at the top. Go to Hollow Knight: Silksong on Steam, right-click and press "Properties...". In Launch Options, paste the the arguments Cogfly copied for you and start your game. If this still doesn't work, make sure your Silksong folder doesn't have any BepInEx files (folder and doorstop files) from the manual installation. This *can* conflict with the mod managers and Cogfly will place these back for you. Worst case scenario, delete your Silksong folder, reinstall it using Verify Integrity of Game Files, relaunch Cogfly, then import the a new profile with one of the codes. ### Cogfly - Getting a Server Returned HTTP Response Code 502 Error This has been happening for a little bit where it seems that Cogfly is having a connection issue with Thunderstore. Try manually installing the mod list using the photo below, [swap to R2Modman](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer#using-r2modman-3218--thunderstore-manager-11231) using the same code, or try a [manual install](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer#manually). ### Additional common issues or troubleshooting steps to take - If Silksong does not connect, confirm that BepInEx is installed correctly and that the plugin is in the `BepInEx/plugins` folder. - If the Silksong world does not appear in Archipelago, confirm that the `.apworld` is in `custom_worlds` and restart the Archipelago launcher. - If items or checks appear out of sync, reconnect the client or use the client's resynchronization command if available. - If reporting a bug, include the randomizer version, Archipelago version, relevant YAML settings, and the BepInEx log. ## Feedback and Bug Reports Please report bugs and logic issues through the repository's [issues](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer/issues) page. Include enough information to reproduce the problem, but do not upload save files containing personal information. A second place to give this feedback can be this [Google Form](https://forms.gle/bAsQ2o453eccpL2i7). A [Trello board](https://trello.com/b/as8YLuLA/skonging) is also available to post known bugs, what's been fixed, and what's upcoming. ## Support and Additional Information The best place to get any further support would be [Archipelago's Discord](https://discord.gg/archipelago) where you can access the [Hollow Knight: Silksong (Batsong Implementation)](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1540758118361727056) channel. This is a reminder that this is a passion project and people will try to help to the best of their ability but as always, please be respectful. ## Credits A huge thanks goes out to all that support the channel and thread, the logic mapping team, playtesters, mod developers, and others who have helped contribute to this project: ### Logic Mapping Some of these regions are still incomplete and still being mapped out. Long answer, it can cause softlocks and other issues, it can be used but at your own risk of issues and potential woodchipper related incidents. ### I Got An Error Saying My APWorld Version is Incompatible This occurs when you've changed your Randomizer Mod to a new version for an update while having your world generated on an old one. Use one of the installation methods to downgrade. Manual is preferred for downgrading. Given that Cogfly has some issues currently with import codes, you can downgrade manually by pressing the link attached to the version numbers below and then follow the steps. Alternatively, you can always replace Cogfly with a different mod manager that allows for downgrading. Downgrading on those mod managers can typically be done by uninstalling the mod and then reinstalling it and selecting the appropriate version to your generated run. #### Manual Downgrading 1.) Go to your BepInEx plugins folder, depending on your install this is located in one of two places. - For a manual installation it should be in your game directory. - For a mod manager, you want to go into the profile folder. For R2ModMan, this is in "Settings > Profile Folder". For Cogfly, go into the profile and press "Open Profile Folder". 2.) Go into the "BepInEx" folder. Go into the "plugins" folder. Go into the "Silksong Randomizer" folder this can also be named "BatAtVideoGames-SilksongArchipelagoRandomizer". A file named "SilksongRandomizer.dll" will be present in the folder, you want to replace this file using the version in one of the .rar files from below. 3.) Start up your game normally after replacing and you should be able to connect once again. #### Old Import Codes [**v0.5.5**](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer/releases/tag/v0.5.5) Import Code: `01a1bd74-2ab1-af6c-d1e3-7d4c97d62492` [**v0.5.4**](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer/releases/tag/v0.5.4) Import Code: `01a199f2-e780-ee3e-dcf9-9cdff4c98dce` [**v0.5.3**](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer/releases/tag/v0.5.3) Import Code: `01a18ae7-61f6-2d35-4c42-ed7578c6fc75` [**v0.5.2**](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer/releases/tag/v0.5.2) Import Code: `01a15150-4496-f47c-5102-41aae48899c7` [**v0.5.1**](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer/releases/tag/v0.5.1) Import Code: `01a12cf3-f4cb-5402-d6a8-0f266b3e7aa8` [**v0.5.0**](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer/releases/tag/v0.5.0) Import Code: `01a109ba-4c4f-b4f0-8695-8b4d42cb8159` ### My Mod Manager Boots The Game In Vanilla For **Cogfly**, press 'Copy Launch Arguments' at the top. Go to Hollow Knight: Silksong on Steam, right-click and press "Properties...". In Launch Options, paste the the arguments Cogfly copied for you and start your game. If this still doesn't work, make sure your Silksong folder doesn't have any BepInEx files (folder and doorstop files) from the manual installation. This *can* conflict with the mod managers and Cogfly will place these back for you. Worst case scenario, delete your Silksong folder, reinstall it using Verify Integrity of Game Files, relaunch Cogfly, then import the a new profile with one of the codes. ### Cogfly - Getting a Server Returned HTTP Response Code 502 Error This has been happening for a little bit where it seems that Cogfly is having a connection issue with Thunderstore. Try manually installing the mod list using the photo below, [swap to R2Modman](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer#using-r2modman-3218--thunderstore-manager-11231) using the same code, or try a [manual install](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer#manually). ### Additional common issues or troubleshooting steps to take - If Silksong does not connect, confirm that BepInEx is installed correctly and that the plugin is in the `BepInEx/plugins` folder. - If the Silksong world does not appear in Archipelago, confirm that the `.apworld` is in `custom_worlds` and restart the Archipelago launcher. - If items or checks appear out of sync, reconnect the client or use the client's resynchronization command if available. - If reporting a bug, include the randomizer version, Archipelago version, relevant YAML settings, and the BepInEx log. ## Feedback and Bug Reports Please report bugs and logic issues through the repository's [issues](https://github.com/Batatvideogames/silksong-archipelago-randomizer/issues) page. Include enough information to reproduce the problem, but do not upload save files containing personal information. A second place to give this feedback can be this [Google Form](https://forms.gle/bAsQ2o453eccpL2i7). A [Trello board](https://trello.com/b/as8YLuLA/skonging) is also available to post known bugs, what's been fixed, and what's upcoming. ## Support and Additional Information The best place to get any further support would be [Archipelago's Discord](https://discord.gg/archipelago) where you can access the [Hollow Knight: Silksong (Batsong Implementation)](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1540758118361727056) channel. This is a reminder that this is a passion project and people will try to help to the best of their ability but as always, please be respectful. ## Credits A huge thanks goes out to all that support the channel and thread, the logic mapping team, playtesters, mod developers, and others who have helped contribute to this project: ### Logic Mapping Some of these regions are still incomplete and still being mapped out. > [!WARNING]
> ## As of this update Archipelago 0.6.8 is the minimum version required, if you're still running 0.6.7 please update the launcher [here](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases)

The _pretty_ update. Very happy with all the major changes, glhf and enjoy.
(Also as per usual if you enjoy these and want to [buy me a coffee](https://streamlabs.com/batatvideogames/tip) I'd appreciate it)

# Changelog 

## Major 

- Randomized shell shard caches and rosary rocks now retain their original appearance, break in 1 hit and display the rosary/AP badge
    - (most logic has not been adjusted for it yet like the Deep Docks shards no longer needing Magma Bell but will in future releases)
- DeathLink and its cocoon behaviour can now be changed in mod settings without regenerating your seed. DeathLink statistics in inventory appear only while DeathLink is enabled
- Added an optional Recent Items panel showing your five latest sent and received items with icons. Enable it in mod settings or toggle with F9
- Map markers are now a mod setting that can be toggled between: Off, Mapped Rooms, Owned Maps, and All. These can be changed any time during your run. You can choose between an AP Icon for all the map markers or a category-based pin icon for what each location is.
   - The mod settings can be adjusted in the BepInEx config file but the [ModMenu mod](https://thunderstore.io/package/download/silksong_modding/ModMenu/0.7.6/) helps doing that seamlessly during gameplay
- Updated Abyss, Putrified Ducts, Memorium, Bone Bottom, Hunters March, Whiteward, Bilewater, Sinners Road, Far Fields, High Halls and Choral Chambers logic

## Minor

- Fixed several seconds of lag when entering Greymoor East Bellshrine Room from the Silver Shells Room after breaking the connecting wall
- Fixed resending missing major keys and melodies through Archipelago. Keys already used to open their doors remain spent
- Restored Terminus Silkeater and Whispering Vaults Mask Shard to Act 2 randomization
- Added Pilgrim’s Rest Board to lore randomization
- Fixed the missing Far Fields map-shop marker in Universal Tracker
- Added the Shaman Crest Ritual Recipe to lore randomization
- Added the missing rosary/AP badge to randomized grave markers
- Removed the incorrect AP connection tag
- Restored ten incorrectly excluded pickups across Act 1 and Act 2 runs
- Fixed the Craftmetal counter showing an incorrect amount after repairing a ruined tool
- Whispering Vaults silkeater which incorrectly had "none" as logical requirements got corrected
- Bone Bottom starts use the town bench with a valid return checkpoint
- With wish-shuffle Mooshka and the Moss Druid now explain when their required wish hasn’t been accepted. This explanation remains readable during alphabet rando
- F4 now immediately stops the Silk Soar shrine's looping screen shake
- Corrected room images, including missing backgrounds and Act 3 scenery appearing on earlier-act maps
- Surface Memento now correctly requires Needolin
- Fixed an “item handling flags” connection error when Crowd Control is installed
- Added Swift's first-race necklace to Rosary Necklace randomization
- Fixed wish shuffle allowing progression items behind Bellhome before Restoration was available
- Fixed map scrolling stopping short of edge markers, including Surface Memento
- Fixed renewable Rosary logic incorrectly requiring a non-Architect crest
- Fixed missing Rosary requirements for Grand Gate, Whispering Vaults, Memorium and Cradle map purchases
- Removed the unused Fleatopia Rosary Necklace and Rosary String checks from new seeds and maps
- Fixed logic integration for Sprintmaster's Memento, Guardian's Memento, Dark Hearts and Garb of the Pilgrims
- Shellwood grave area no longer has an incorrect enemy pogo requirement
- Other individual logic fixes that I'd go bald trying to document because these people work fast

## Beta stuff

- Fixed several rescue wishes appearing in logic without the enemy souls needed to complete them
- Styx's bench remains usable until both Styx and Muckroach souls are owned
- Caravan readiness now accounts for Mooshka's soul
- Enemy soul rando now marks rooms containing enemies whose souls you own but haven't killed yet. Killing a species anywhere removes it from all markers
